folders.examples/arith: Recursive addition and multiplication on Peano naturals.
folders.examples/back: Bidirectional typechecker with even/odd nat subtyping on a small λ-language.
folders.examples/bigstep-deterministic: Big-step evaluation for λ-terms; proof that evaluation results are unique.
folders.examples/cfg: Coverage-checker stress tests using a free-variable analysis on typed expressions.
folders.examples/church-rosser: Church–Rosser for β on untyped λ via parallel reduction (Tait–Martin-Löf). Folder holds several developments; test.cfg loads the parallel-reduction proof chain.
folders.examples/codatatypes: Coinductive examples: pi-calculus bisimulation, Howe's method, and a Tofte-style environment semantics.
folders.examples/compile: Pfenning's compiler-correctness suite in Elf—SECD/CLS machines, CPS, closure conversion, and de Bruijn compilation.
folders.examples/copy: Structurally recursive deep copy of λ-terms; simply-typed and dependently typed variants.
folders.examples/count-var: Count variable occurrences in typed terms; illustrates pattern matching when types are refined in branches.
folders.examples/cpp13: Type-preserving closure conversion and CPS for a higher-order language.
folders.examples/cut-elim: Cut elimination for intuitionistic sequent calculus (Pfenning); Beluga and Elf versions.
folders.examples/equal: Soundness and completeness of algorithmic versus declarative equality on λ-terms.
folders.examples/fol: Intuitionistic logic: propositional proof search and a first-order Hilbert–natural-deduction translation.
folders.examples/free-vars: Decide whether a well-typed expression contains a free variable.
folders.examples/freshML: FreshML-style compilation: de Bruijn conversion, CPS, closure conversion, and environment passing.
folders.examples/higher-order: Third-order HOAS paths through λ-terms; shown equivalent to a second-order path judgment.
folders.examples/improve: Small examples that stress η-conversion and type reconstruction in patterns.
folders.examples/lincx_mechanization: LINCX linear logical framework: linear and unrestricted contexts, typing, substitution, and context join.
folders.examples/literate_beluga: Literate tutorial proofs from the Beluga docs—beginner through advanced, including POPLmark and normalization.
folders.examples/logrel: Logical relations for weak head normalization and algorithmic equality on STLC (Cave & Pientka, LFMTP 2013).
folders.examples/lp-horn: Horn-clause intuitionistic logic: canonical and uniform proof search, adapted from Twelf.
folders.examples/mini-ml: Mini-ML with substitution-based call-by-value evaluation, type preservation, and value soundness.
folders.examples/path: Paths through λ-term structure; agreeing on all paths implies β-conversion.
folders.examples/polylam: Normalize simply-typed λ-terms into a value-only representation.
folders.examples/popl12: Examples from the POPL 2012 Beluga paper: NbE, closure conversion, lists, and normalization.
folders.examples/poplmark: POPLmark challenge 1a: bounded subtype polymorphism (proof-pearl development).
folders.examples/poplmark-reloaded: POPLmark Reloaded 1a–2b: strong normalization via accessibility on step-indexed terms.
folders.examples/poplmark-reloaded+: Alternate encoding of the POPLmark Reloaded strong-normalization development.
folders.examples/small-step: Small-step STLC and System F with preservation and progress; includes a progress proof using inversion.
folders.examples/tapl: TAPL-style exercises: arithmetic and boolean evaluation, exceptions, and STLC big- and small-step semantics.
folders.examples/typed-compilation: Type-preserving CPS and closure conversion (Twelf POPL tutorial), plus de Bruijn shifting.
folders.examples/typed-eval: Type-directed evaluator for booleans, naturals, and let; only well-typed terms run.
folders.examples/unique: Uniqueness of typing and of evaluation results in a simply-typed λ-calculus.
folders.case-studies/classical-processes: Session types in Beluga (Sano, Kavanagh, Pientka, OOPSLA 2023): linearity, typing, and subject reduction for CP.
folders.case-studies/harmony-lemma-formalization: Harmony Lemma for π-calculus (Cecilia & Momigliano, LFMTP 2024): labeled transitions versus structural reduction.
